findings.doc_quote: re-runs on app reload (triggered by hassette reload , or by config changes when automatic reloads are on)
findings.code_evidence: src/hassette/cli/__init__.py:74 `apps_app = App(name="app", ...)` and :114 `apps_app.command(cmd_app_reload, name="reload")`. There is no top-level `reload` command.
findings.explanation: The reload command is a subcommand of `app`. The invocation is `hassette app reload <key>`, not `hassette reload`.
findings.suggested_fix: triggered by `hassette app reload <key>`, or by config changes when automatic reloads are on

summary: The page is almost entirely accurate. I checked every signature, default, and exception (the `run_*` methods, `register`, `schedule`, `add_job`), and all matched `scheduler.py` and `triggers.py`. I also checked the minimum-delay and whole-second validation, the `if_exists` semantics, the `Job.matches` fields, and the `job_timeout_seconds` default. The one error is the CLI command name on line 156. I did not independently verify the `where=` skip/error semantics, the `replace` mode-cancellation details, the `timeout` default inheritance, or the config-reload claim.
